archangel.description.rules: Append [+] to indicate upside, [-] for downside and [~] for tweaks.
archangel.cherubmod.Temperance.2: Second power description here. Long paragraphs wrap horizontally and trigger vertical scrolling automatically.
archangel.cherubmod.Strength.1: [+] Your barehand punches are empowered to deal great damage, even more so against bulky enemies.
archangel.cherubmod.Strength.2: [+] Your punches shatter armor, dealing additional, armor-piercing damage the more armor your target has.
archangel.cherubmod.Strength.3: [+] Sneak while punching to instead slam the ground, dealing reduced damage in a large radius.
archangel.cherubmod.Strength.4: [-] You deal nearly no damage while holding anything.
